_comment: The lava river section of the ring: the deck between bearings 292.3 and 338.3 (r 46.7..57.3) replaced by a river brimming at y=22.3, 0.7 m under the deck, with rock shores at both ends. It comes out of the rock along the WHOLE foot of the shaft wall -- one low slot at r 57.3 from 293.3 to 337.3 deg, head y=22.80, back at r 59.4, so neither the wall nor the deck over it is ever cut -- and leaves over the inner lip as ONE continuous sheet down the section's whole inner edge, falling from y 22.3 to y -11.5 into the pit's lava sea (r 46.62 at the lip, swinging in to 42.1 so it stays inside map_base's jittered pit wall). Seven rock pillars stand 1.2 m out of the river, tops flat at y=23.5, 7.00 m centre to centre; the three inner ones carry a cover fin to y=27.3. Authored in WORLD coordinates -- instance at identity. TWO surfaces: HellRock (the tower atlas) and LavaRiver (its own tiling sheet, emissive, streaked along the flow -- radial on the river, vertical on the sheet -- double-sided). LakeCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node -- rock above y 22.5, pillar tops and sides, fins -- and carries NO lava and NO fall: the scene's TrapVolume owns the kill. LavaSurface is an empty at the river height, centre of the section.
